dialogues.jp:
昨日と変わらず、ことりは元気がないままだっ
た。うなだれたような姿。顔に、生気がない。
dialogues.en:
Just like yesterday, Kotori still seemed depressed today.
She seemed drained of any vitality.
dialogues.text:
Just like yesterday, Kotori still seemed depressed today.
She seemed drained of any vitality.

dialogues.jp:
クラスメートも、そんな様子を感じ取っている
のか、誰も話しかけようとはしないようだった。
dialogues.en:
Our classmates, sensing something wrong, decided not to
interfere with her and talk among themselves instead.
dialogues.text:
Our classmates, sensing something wrong, decided not to
interfere with her and talk among themselves instead.

dialogues.jp: ことりとみんなとで、空気がまるで違う。
dialogues.en: Kotori was definitely giving off a different air than usual.
dialogues.text: Kotori was definitely giving off a different air than usual.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.en: "Alright, good morning~ Return to your desks."
dialogues.text: "Alright, good morning~ Return to your desks."

dialogues.jp:
暦先生の声に、意識が黒板の方へと引き寄せら
れる。思わず、ため息がもれた。
dialogues.en:
At Koyomi-sensei's voice, my senses went to the blackboard
in front of me. I instinctively sighed.
dialogues.text:
At Koyomi-sensei's voice, my senses went to the blackboard
in front of me. I instinctively sighed.

dialogues.jp:
昨日と変わらず元気のないことり。うなだれた
ようなその姿に思わず、ため息がもれた。
dialogues.en:
Just like yesterday, Kotori was still depressed. Her head
dropped, and she sighed constantly.
dialogues.text:

dropped, and she sighed constantly.
